_note: Core book, Typical Operations (p. 113) — the main categories of job shadowrunners get hired for. Descriptions are paraphrased, not quoted, and the book's own flavor examples (the Manadyne/MCT/TerraFirst! vignettes) are skipped for the same reason. Order follows the book's own listing. Most real missions mix several of these rather than being a pure single type.

extraction.label: Extraction
extraction.description: Move a VIP out of their current situation, willing or not. Often plays out like a kidnapping when the target doesn't know they're being pulled out.

investigation.label: Investigation
investigation.description: Chase down physical, digital, or astral leads — find someone, pin a crime on them, vet a contact, recover something missing, or dig up dirt. Often feeds into a different job rather than being the whole point.

infiltration.label: Infiltration
infiltration.description: Talk, bribe, or sneak your way into a secured location to gather intel or plant surveillance, rather than kicking in the front door.

theft.label: Theft
theft.description: Take something the client can't buy, borrow, or beg for. The classic shadowrunner job.

sabotage.label: Sabotage
sabotage.description: Cripple a target's facilities, gear, or reputation to blunt their ability to operate.

wetwork.label: Wetwork
wetwork.description: Assassinate a target — a person, a rival operative, or a dangerous critter.

smash-and-grab.label: Smash-and-Grab
smash-and-grab.description: Hit a location hard and fast to grab a specific item or loot valuables, then get out before anyone can respond.

smuggling.label: Smuggling
smuggling.description: Move illegal or sensitive cargo — goods, data, or people — across a border or through secured territory.

courier.label: Courier
courier.description: Pick up a package or data and deliver it somewhere else without losing it, or getting caught holding it, along the way.

protection.label: Protection
protection.description: Guard a person or location against an incoming threat, physical, digital, or magical.

deception.label: Deception
deception.description: Plant false evidence, spread rumors, or otherwise run a smear campaign to shape what people believe about a target.
